Hi Nadia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great overview of Storlytics' use case for embeddings-driven search and the backfill requirements. Quick recap and a short ask so we can move the commercial/technical track in parallel: 

Recap (from our call 2026-07-21):
- Primary use case: semantic search across customer support docs (800k docs initially).
- Performance target: <120ms 95th for 512-token requests during business hours.
- Data posture: customer PII redaction in upstream ETL; plan to host in our VPC (preferred).

What we need from you to progress to an internal pricing + contracting milestone:
1) Approver inventory — who are the names/emails for the following roles?
   - Economic buyer / business sponsor (final sign-off)
   - Legal / contracting owner (who'll review redlines)
   - Procurement contact (PO / procurement lead)
   - Security / compliance contact (SOC2/data residency/questions)
   - Infra/ops contact (SSO/KMS/integration owner)

2) If you have an org chart or a simple CSV mapping role->name->email, can you attach it? A one-page PDF is ideal.

3) Any internal decision criteria or procurement timing (e.g., quarter-end budget, SSO required before purchase)? Knowing the timeline helps us prioritize security evidence vs. pricing flex.

Next step suggestion: 30-min alignment call next week with your procurement + security contact, and I'll bring Laura (engineering lead) to walk security posture and SSO options. I attached our MAP template (RWI-MAP-template.xlsx) so you can drop names in — feel free to send back.

Thanks — we want to make this low-friction. Proposed times: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Best,
